title: The King's Hit List, Part 2
description: The King's Hit List, Part 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: You think Sir Ving N'Seacressy asked you to Contact an Undercover Operative in Dew Valley.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: The King's Hit List, Part 3

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: You think Sir Ving N'Seacressy asked you to Contact an Undercover Operative in Dew Valley.

Offer:

So, if you would have gone into the Shadow's Embrace you might have seen how things were going in there. You would have probably noticed that the Guild of Shadows was a little on edge. I wonder why they *are* so on edge? I mean, if you were to have done that, and told me about it, then I would possibly be wondering why, but this is all supposition anyway...right?

*Sir Ving N'Seacressy starts closing and opening his eyes as if he has been poked in the eye with a Ten Ton Hammer. You figure that he must be trying to wink.*

So, if there was a problem in the Shadow's Embrace we would need to start gathering some information, in theory. If we were to seek information we would possibly start with talking to an undercover operative I might know in Dew Valley. When you find this operative, I would most likely tell you to tell them find a balled up piece of paper to make the sun come out again.

Turn-in:

Hello there, do I know you? You don't look like a newbie. What's that? Who wants me to find a balled up piece of paper to make the sun come out again? I see, Sir Ving N'Seacressy must have sent you. Look, tell him I've got the three King's Coin I owe him for that trip down to the Horrific Dungeon of Legend and he doesn't have to send some pathetic lackey, nothing personal, to remind me.

Client level range: 45–100
